question: How many medals did India win at Tokyo 2020 Olympics?
solution:
The correct answer is __**7**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **India won a total of 7 medals** at the **Tokyo 2020 Olympics**, which marked its most successful Olympic campaign ever.
 
• The medal tally included **1 gold, 2 silver, and 4 bronze medals**.
 
• **Neeraj Chopra** made history by winning India’s first-ever Olympic gold medal in athletics in the **Men’s Javelin Throw** event.
 
• The silver medals were won by **Mirabai Chanu** in **Weightlifting (49 kg category)** and **Ravi Kumar Dahiya** in **Men’s Wrestling (57 kg category)**.
 
• The bronze medals were won by **P.V. Sindhu** (Badminton - Women’s Singles), **Lovlina Borgohain** (Boxing - Women’s Welterweight), the **Indian Men’s Hockey Team**, and **Bajrang Punia** (Wrestling - Men’s 65 kg category).
